title: Firelord (612)
problem: Firelord adds 0.2 × total_attacks × base to the attack's bonus pool. That pool is zeroed only before the hit loop and never between hits, so hit k receives the terms of hits 1..k. total_attacks is raised by the hit count only after the loop. This matches the community's numbers. It is the general multi-hit pile-up bug (R1), which affects every "% more damage" term of an attack, not only Firelord.
notes: Community claim: In a multi-hit attack each hit gets the full accumulated bonus times its position (+120% / +240% / +360%), though each set only adds 20% per hit to the count. Evidence: bc_CreatureAttack L1593-L1594: gate @0x1406e7766, pool([rsp+0x3b8]) += base([rsp+0x350]) × 0.2 × total_attacks @0x1406e797d / 0x1406e798d; pool zeroed L10 / L88 only; hit loop L1076-L1892 (back-jump @0x1406f6748); total_attacks += hits L1922 @0x1406f72dd. Fix sketch: Zero the pool at the start of each hit (H) Triage 2026-10-26: merged into SU-0038.
reason: duplicate of SU-0038 (multi-hit bonus pile-up), which is now fixed (normalized, user ruling 2026-10-26); Touch of Red's own term is SU-0176.
